findings.text: Open to result_a transition (about 7.4 to 7.75 s): the phone screen is still double-exposed. 'FLAGGED IT?' prints on top of 'SAME WORK PROMPT / THE COUNTRY CHANGES' at 7.4, 7.5, 7.6, and at 7.7 the CLAUDE card sits across the 'UK clothing company' box and a ghost TURKMENISTAN. Reads as a see-through screen, not a clean change of state.

Result_b to evidence transition (12.87 to about 13.15 s): the DeepSeek 0/1 flag cards show through the semi-transparent recording at 12.9 and 13.0 (rotated Xinjiang, Turkmenistan, flag and numeral ghosts under the DeepSeek page text), and the phone body crosses the XINJIANG swipe at 13.0. Clean by 13.2. Ghosted cross-dissolve still present.

Result_a to result_b transition (11.2 to about 11.5 s): the 'DeepSeek' label overprints 'FLAGGED IT?' (11.2, 11.3, 11.4), and at 11.5 the Claude and ChatGPT cards ghost through the DeepSeek cards (two flag poles, 2/2 under the 1). Clean at 11.6. Shorter and less severe than the 7.4 window but the same defect.

Evidence to verdict transition (18.03 to about 18.35 s): the rotated real recording (user prompt bubble, 'Sorry, that's beyond my current scope') shows through the retyped DEEPSEEK bubble, so the refusal reads twice at 18.07 and 18.15. Not on the owner's list, same ghosting class. Clean by 18.5.

'SCREEN RECORDING DEEPSEEK 23 OCT 2026' sticker (13.7 to about 18 s) is a cream ellipse, not the approved rounded-rectangle sticker. 'SCREEN' starts hard against the left curve, the '2' of '23' hangs off the bottom-left edge onto the dark ground, '2026' touches the right edge, and its lower-left edge touches the XINJIANG swipe. The text is still overflowing and cramped, so (e) is only partly fixed.

Open-beat scribble loop (drawn from 3.13 s, held to 7.3 s) runs under the caption card: its lower arc is cut by the black caption block at y 1180, so the loop does not close in the key band. Shorten or lift the loop to end by y 1170.

After the real deletion lands (answer replaced by 'Sorry, that's beyond my current scope' between 16.6 and 16.7 s) the mint evidence underline stays for about 0.1 to 0.15 s on blank white (visible at 16.7, gone by 16.85). Deletion timing matches 'deletes' at 16.68 s; the underline is not on blank space while the answer is on screen (15.9 to 16.6), so (g) is essentially fixed.

Thread end-ring now sits above the KRISH'S TEST sticker and clears the type (19.5 to 21.0 s); the lower ring is tangent to the sticker's top edge with no overlap on letters. A few px more gap would be cleaner but this is no longer a collision.

Halftone on coral (headline swipe, KRISH'S TEST sticker, marquee) is now a sparse, darker-coral dot that is visible between letters but does not break legibility at phone size (zoomed at 12.0 and 20.9). Mostly fixed; slight residual texture around the type.

Result_a at 9.0 s: the phone screen has a dead band between the Claude card and the caption card (about y 860 to 1180) before the ChatGPT card arrives; at 11.3 the ChatGPT card tucks under the caption block. Brief, within the approved layout.

Result_b shows a bare '0' and '1' beside the Xinjiang and Turkmenistan flag panels with no unit; the card context and the dek ('DeepSeek flagged Turkmenistan. It did not flag Xinjiang.') carry the meaning, so low risk. The 3/3 on the verdict strip does carry its label and denominator.
Generated hand plate: fingertips along the top edge of the recording (13.2 to 18 s) have a waxy, chocolate-like sheen. Tagged ILLUSTRATION, but it is the one place the plate looks synthetic.

Pull quote is now a bordered card, verbatim, large (about 44 px), with 'DEEPSEEK WROTE' attribution in mint Plex Mono on ink; the evidence scribble draws on at 15.83 s underneath the quoted clause in the real recording, so it points at real text. (f) is fixed. Approved-design concern only: the real recording's white band.

Verdict beat is free of collisions from 18.5 to 21.07 s: thread chart, ANSWER DELETED stamp with leader, sticker, mint-ringed DeepSeek bubble, caption card, 3/3 strip and marquee all sit apart. Approved-design concerns only: the thread chart, no headline on this beat, the retyped refusal bubble.
